x: Two of the above have already distinguished themselves : Saward, by winning our hurdles handicap and Daley, by being placed in a recent novice race promoted by the Metropolitan W.C.; whilst Harold Wills, who is a first-claim member to our friends and rivals, Herne Hill Harriers, is already well-known to many of us.
Before we had time to chill again, H.

First Jack, then Penny, and afterwards Harold Wills, our second-claim member from Herne Hill Harriers, tried to dispute the lead with Allum, between the bottom of the hill and Beverley Brook, but gave it up in disgust.
